summary: SPAC Translational Development Acquisition Corp. (TDAC) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a Business Combination Agreement with Prologium Holding Inc. (ProLogium). Under the plan, TDAC will merge via a two-step reverse merger into ProLogium, becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary. The filing does not state the enterprise value, price per share, premium, or break fee. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The mechanics involve a recapitalization followed by sequential mergers of SPAC subs. The deal is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. The key watch item is the redemption rate of SPAC shares, which will determine the cash available at close.
